Container.Name: Deckle
Container.Overview:
Deckle builds a morning newspaper from your town's news and weather, your RSS feeds and the articles you saved, and has it waiting on your e-ink reader. This is the headless container: it runs the Daily on a schedule, keeps every edition in a Morgue folder, and emails the paper to a Kindle through your own mail account. Any export folder works too. The Deckle app runs in your browser on port 8080 once you set a web UI password.
What doesn't work here: Kindle book conversion (Enhanced Typesetting, X-Ray, Word Wise) needs Kindle Previewer, which only runs on Mac and Windows. The first start writes a starter digest.toml in the config folder; edit it in the web UI or the file, then restart the container. Set the Kindle email password in DECKLE_SMTP_PASSWORD. Setup: https://github.com/CasaVargas/deckle/blob/main/docs/docker.md

Config.Name: Data
Config.Description: The Morgue, library, Inbox and export folders (Deckle/ inside).

Config.Name: PUID
Config.Description: User id the files are written as (99 is nobody).

Config.Name: PGID
Config.Description: Group id the files are written as (100 is users).

Config.Name: TZ
Config.Description: Time zone. Papers print on this zone's clock.

Config.Name: Web UI port
Config.Description: The Deckle app in your browser.

Config.Name: Web UI password
Config.Description: The password the web UI asks for; 12 or more characters. Without one the web UI stays off and only the schedule runs.

Config.Name: Kindle email password
Config.Description: Password for the [email] account that sends the paper to your Kindle. Leave blank if you don't email it.

Config.Name: Bookmarklet port
Config.Description: Optional. Lets a browser bookmarklet save pages to tomorrow's paper.

Config.Name: Bookmarklet address
Config.Description: Optional. The address your browser reaches the port at, as scheme://host[:port] with no path, e.g. http://tower.local:47219.
